51c75f7bb6f26ba1cd00002f: Through pretend play, Barney, and the children learn about their community and the people that help them live safely and happily there.

The children are invited to a family picnic in the park, but don't know who invited them.  The invitations instruct them to bring a family treasure, so each child has something special with them.  Barney helps lead a discussion about families.
A "too hot" afternoon becomes a "totally cool" day when Barney introduces his friends to the wonders of water.
While Barney and the children wait for Mr. Boyd's new fountain to be delivered, they have fun playing in and exploring the park.
Barney helps his young friends find good ways to express and deal with angry emotions.
Mario is trying to write his very own fairy tale.  The children help by acting out some of their favorite fairy tales to give Mario some ideas.

The children are surprised to learn that playing games and having fun in the park is great exercise.  Baby Bop is happy to learn that not only is she exercising while she plays, but exercise will make her grow big and strong.

Although the park may be a home away from home for Barney and his friends, BJ wants to build his own "totally awesome, completely cool" house.  While BJ works on his house, Barney and the children learn all about houses and homes.
With a little Barney magic, the children experience the differences between day and night!

When Tony brings his kite to the park to show his friends, it accidentally blows into the branches of a tree!  While waiting for a breeze to blow the kite down, Barney, Baby Bop and the kids play games about "up" and "down."
Barney, Baby Bop and the kids learn all about “on” and “off” by playing games together.
A tea party planned by the children turns into a fun opportunity to reinforce lessons about good manners!  Throughout the day, Baby Bop is given helpful advice.
Barney, BJ and the kids spend the day preparing for a performance for their friends in the park.
Throughout the day, Barney and the children learn about "hot" and "cold," but the fun really begins when Barney turns the playground into a winter/summer wonderland!

It's always fun to share a day with Barney—but it's also important to learn how to "play it safe!"  Baby Bop, wanting to be a good helper, has been attaching adhesive strips to her frustrated (and uninjured) brother, BJ.

Angela is in the park to release her turtle after observing him with her classmates in school.  Barney and the children discuss the meaning of in and out after observing the turtle going in and out of his shell.
The children learn about many different countries while experiencing an “International Fair” on the playground.
When Miss Jo loses her cat, Barney and the children spend the day helping her find it.  Along the way, they learn all about cats.

Beth has invented a brand-new holiday called "Happy Day," in which everyone gets to make a wish for something which will make them happy—and everyone else tries to make that wish come true!  Barney and the kids discuss feelings and facial expressions.
The children learn all about the piano when they play games, listen to real pianos and even play a little themselves.

After playing with "Stop" and "Go" signs with Angela, Baby Bop leaves to direct some traffic of her own!  Meanwhile, in the caboose, Barney and the kids enjoy a costume parade, a game of "Musical Stop & Go," and some very vigorous body movement.

It's the day of the bike parade.  But Nick has had a bike accident that leaves his bike in need of repair by Mr. Boyd.  Barney helps Baby Bop and the children learn all about bicycles—and that they are a wonderful way to exercise and have fun.

Barney helps Baby Bop and the children discover big and little things in the world around them.  And by the end of the day, the kids have learned that big or little, they're all wonderful just the way they are!
Barney and the children have fun playing with and learning about busses and cars.
The children bring toys to donate to Mr. Boyd's toy drive.  Baby Bop and BJ arrive and after some convincing, Baby Bop learns about the merits of sharing.
A day of imaginative play and fun for Barney and his young friends is kicked off by the arrival of a variety of boxes from the "Enjoy-Your-Toys Company."  Surprisingly, every box is empty!
Barney and the kids help Baby Bop count to ten by playing games, and visiting a Make-Believe Market.
Nick's homework is to find as many squares as he can.  It's great fun when Barney and the kids help!
Kami, one of Barney's youngest friends, has trouble keeping up with the other kids and she's tired of always being last.  She's not having a very good day.

It's a rainy spring day, and the children can be found inside painting and creating.  Barney arrives, explains the differences amongst the seasons, and suggests playing outside in the rain.  The rain is soon replaced by sunshine and a rainbow.
Every day with Barney is fun—but today is extra special.  It's Barney's birthday!

Tony shares a box full of numbers that he made with his dad.  He is showing them off when a gust of wind blows them all away.  Barney and the kids decide to go on a number hunt.  They soon find Baby Bop and their hunt takes the group all over the park.

Barney and the kids are excited because five of Mr. Boyd's brass-playing buddies are putting on a show in the park tonight!  Angela is learning to play the trumpet and knows that it takes a lot of practice.  BJ arrives and the group visits the caboose.

68513950f212bedacf8ec48f: Huset vakler stadig etter matche-seremonien og etablerte par splittes. Men mer hjertesorg er på gang...
Det er kjærlighet i luften for visse par, men kan de gå inn i spillet når de ikke passer sammen? Tiden løper ut for å finne alle de ti perfekte parene, og spenningen koker.
Det står 200 pund på spill i den siste matche-seremonien. Singlene må bruke hodet og hjertet, men risikerer å måtte dra tomhendte.

Parene diskuterer sexlivet sitt under en 'kåtchat' som fører til spekulasjon om hvem som er ekte eller bløff. Særlig siden et par avslører at de ikke er monogame. Derfor koker spenningen over under Sannhetsseremonien.
Det er nedtelling mot finalen, men bør parene prøve å stemme ut løgnerne eller satse på strategi og taktikk for å kunne vinne pengeprisen? Et par ruster seg for kamp.
Det er kun få par igjen, og de har aldri vært så utsatte. Men klarer bløffmakerne å holde på løgnene sine? Presset øker og parene gjør alt for å unngå eliminasjon så sent i spillet.
Kampen om å bli siste par og vinnerne av en livsavgjørende pengesum tilspisser seg. Men Tori har et endelig ess i ermet Vinnerne kunngjøres under sluttseremonien, men er de elskere eller løgnere?

Brad blir spurt om å style Dorion, og hans ferdigheter settes på prøve. Todrick prøver å få klarhet i alt. Jaymes nyter å være nygift med Jonathan Bennett. Curtis er urolig for skuespillerkarrieren, og Joeys forlovelsesfest tar helt av.

Todrick er urolig for sin kommende Pride-opptreden mens Curtis håndterer forholdet til familien. Joey prøver å godtgjøre oppførselen sin. Jaymes henvender seg til Brad for moderlige råd. Dorion håndterer et stort nederlag under en fotografering.

Gjengen drar på Pride for å støtte Todricks opptreden. Brad hjelper Curtis med hans rolle i homoverdenen, mens Jaymes bekymrer seg om Joey kommer på hans 'parykk og vin'-fest. Spenningen stiger i gruppen under rmiddagen.

Todrick kjemper med nervene når han forbereder seg for Pride-opptredenen. Joey og Dorion treffes for første gang siden krangelen. Curtis begynner å like sin plass i fellesskapet, og Jaymes når bristepunktet med gutta.

Brads søster kommer på besøk, og Curtis feirer fødselsdag. Joey og Brians foreldre treffes for første gang. Todricks spillekveld avslører et antall overraskelser, og Dorion undrer over sin plass i vennegjengen.

Curtis får innblikk i skuespillerkarrieren mens Todrick støtter Jaymes. Joey planlegger bryllup og Dorion slipper en real bombe. Brad arrangerer en sammenkomst hvor en ilter konfrontasjon truer med å ødelegge vennskap for godt.
Geordie-gjengen er tilbake i en eksplosiv ny serie! En gammel venn blir med i familien igjen. Under en bytur oppstår det sprekker i vennegjengen.
En morsom kveld på byen surner fort når Chloe, Nathan og Marty-trekanten koker over og resulterer i en slåsskamp. Like etter bestemmer noen seg for at nok er nok og forlater huset.

Marnie knytter tettere bånd med Aaron når det nærmer seg hans debut som MMA-utøver. Marty vil bli venner med Chloe igjen, og alle elsker at Gaz vender tilbake som single og klar for å treffe nye damer.

Det er Aarons kamp! Marnie blir følsom. Scott & Marty kan ikke oppdrives når de skal tilbake. En nakenfest i badestampen, en matkrig og litt pulehule-action. Altså bare nok en kveld i Geordie Shore-huset!
Anna kunngjør at Scotty og Marty ikke skal komme tilbake. Men gjengen får ikke tid til å deppe, fordi de skal til Roma for å lære italienerne hvordan man fester på Geordie-vis!

Gærningene er i Roma og sjefen Anna har jobb til dem - å vise romerne hvordan man fester i Geordie-stil! Nathan er irritert på Chloe, Gaz og Abbie kommer nærmere hverandre og Aaron forteller Gaz at han vil prøve med Marnie, men vil hun det?
Abbie våkner opp og føler at hun har kontrollen over hennes og Gaz' forhold. Mens Nathan og Chloe blir sammen igjen, drar resten av gjengen på laserkrig der Gaz kun konsentrerer seg om Abbie.

Aaron våkner på bursdagen sin med tømmermenn og en sinna Marnie. På Aarons fest har både Gary og Abbie godt blikk for andre gjester og Marnie gir Aaron en gave han ikke vil komme til å glemme så lett.
